lines.en: I scurry over the bare rock.
I stand barely half a block tall.
My fluffy tail bobs behind me.
I follow the cracks for footholds.
I hop over a stretch of scree.
The wind's strong, so I keep low.
My ears keep swivelling.
I skid to a stop at the ledge.

lines.zh: 我踩松的碎石滚下去了
lines.en: Loose gravel rolls away under me.
I slip into a crack, head only.

lines.zh: 这一片裸岩没什么遮挡
lines.en: There's little cover on this bare rock.
I run a lap around the boulder.

lines.zh: 我坐在岩台上，抱着前爪
lines.en: I sit on the ledge, paws tucked.

lines.zh: 山上风大，我的毛被吹开
lines.en: The wind parts my fur.
I nibble a scrap of dry grass.
My whiskers tremble.

lines.zh: 我听了很久，什么也没有
lines.en: I listen a long while. Nothing.
My kin are on another stone.
These rocks are warm from the sun.

lines.zh: 我把身子团起来，暖一点
lines.en: I curl up to get warm.
My ears are bigger than my body seems.

lines.zh: 我抬头看看有没有猛禽
lines.en: I look up for hunting birds.
I look up. You're enormous.

lines.zh: 你站在岩台上，挡住了风
lines.en: You block the wind on this ledge.
My whiskers twitch — it's the wind.
You're not a hawk, but you're not small.
My tail has risen first.
You're looking at me. I'm not used to it.
My ears turn toward you.

lines.zh: 你的手要是伸过来，我就跑
lines.en: If that hand comes over, I run.
These rocks are mine.
But I could share one.
I squeak and bolt into a crack.
A tuft of my fur comes out.
My hind leg gives; I limp.
I curl into a ball and freeze.

lines.zh: 这一下让我耳朵贴平了
lines.en: That pinned my ears flat.
I darted into a crack; only my tail shows.
Is it still safe behind this stone?
I poke my head out of my fur.
I've no strength to run far.
Don't come any closer.
I know that smell.
I crouch on bare rock, fur thick.
I creep two steps closer, nose twitching.
A bit closer so I can sniff.
Hold still; I'll come to you.

lines.zh: 同类在后面看着，别管它们
lines.en: My kin are watching. Never mind them.
I take it quickly.
This really is very good.
Any more? I can eat more.

lines.zh: 你退开一点，我吃得安心
lines.en: Step back so I can eat in peace.
You touch me and I spring far away.

lines.zh: 我一头钻进石缝，裸岩山峰风太大。
lines.en: I dive into a crevice; the bare peak is windy.
I'm soft. Bumping me doesn't hurt.

lines.zh: 我的长尾巴被你踩住了。
lines.en: You've pinned my long tail.
I shake out my ruffled fur.
I bolt past your feet.
That bump rolls me half a turn.
I get up and run again.
I watch you from behind a rock.
If you don't chase, I'll come out.

lines.zh: 这一群都挤在一块石头上
lines.en: The whole group crowds one stone.
Lean on me. It's warmer.
It's cold up here at night.
We take turns watching the sky.
If a shadow comes, call out.
My fur is thicker than yours.
Less wind here. Come over.
Four of us. That's right.
Squeeze in. Don't fall off.
At dawn we go down for food.
I scoop it over with my forepaws.
I hold it and gnaw twice.
Not edible. I drop it.
I hide it under a stone.
This dried nut goes into my cheek pouch.
My kin come to snatch it.
I run fast with it held tight.

lines.zh: 裸岩峰上，我抱着石头啃。
lines.en: On the bare peak I gnaw on stone.
I try a bite.
Then never mind it.
You've blocked my way to the crack.
I don't like being cornered.
My hind legs are already pushing.
I'll bolt past your feet.

lines.zh: 这一下要是撞上，会很轻
lines.en: If I hit you, it'll be light.
But I've no other choice.
My kin have all run off.
Only me, left at the back.
Then a bite, and run.
Move aside and I'll go.
My fur puffs up — I'm about to bolt.

lines.zh: 我只有半格高，沿着岩缝找落脚处。
lines.en: Half a block tall, I pick my way along the rock seams.
The crack is two steps behind me.
I only need to get inside it.
But your foot is in the way.
Then I can only bite first.
I fix on the gap between your feet.
That's the only way.

lines.zh: 你重心偏了，我看得出来。
lines.en: Your weight's off — I can tell.
I'll bolt the other way.
I wait for your foot to move.
When you move, the gap opens.
My tail is twitching.
My heart beats loud enough to hear.
Then it's now or never.
I'm going past your feet.
I flatten down, ready to bolt.
Your shadow is moving toward me.
I pin my ears back.
I listen to where your feet land.
Three steps, then two.
Your foot has lifted.
That instant is my road.
My hind legs are straight as wire.
My heart is loud enough to hurt.
I make myself as small as I can.
I bump into your ankle.
I nip the edge of your boot.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓了一下你的裤脚
lines.en: My claws catch your trouser leg.
You step back, more from surprise.
I bolt for the crack.
I hit you and roll over myself.
Righted, I dart in again.

lines.zh: 这点力气对你不算什么
lines.en: This much force is nothing to you.
But it's all I have.
Don't bring that foot down.
I clamp my teeth on your shoelace.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也吓到了
lines.en: That startled even me.
One swipe of my claws, then I retreat.
Your trouser cuff comes loose.
I spring over the top of your foot.
I ran into your ankle.
Up again, I bite once more.
This much force can't hurt you.
But I don't want to be stepped on.
I bite and retreat at the same time.

lines.zh: 我从裸岩的缝里钻出来
lines.en: I slip out of a crack in the bare rock.

lines.zh: 山上风大，我们四只挤着
lines.en: Strong wind up here. Four of us huddle.

lines.zh: 我的毛被吹得往一边倒
lines.en: The wind lays my fur to one side.
No trees here. Only stone.
I check the sky, then the ground.

lines.zh: 同类已经在找暖和的石头
lines.en: My kin are already seeking warm stones.
I shake the grit off.
This ledge is enough for us.
The wall below drops out of sight.
I walk a lap along the edge.
Something's climbing up.
First I hide behind the rock cleft.
Burnt fur reeks.

lines.zh: 我从岩台滚下去，摔懵了
lines.en: I roll off the ledge and land dazed.
Water soaks my fur and drags me down.
The blast throws me into a crack.
An arrow grazed my big ear.

lines.zh: 这光晃得我找不到石头
lines.en: That light blinds me to the rocks.
Too starved to manage a hop.

lines.zh: 雷打在裸岩上，我全麻了
lines.en: Lightning hits the bare rock and I go numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有石头，我掉下去
lines.en: No rock under me. I fall.
